kind: Finite reviewer-authored acceptance expectations; not executed whole-game procedures.

cases.given: An acquired Efficient Recycling; actual owned non-copy device, 2 RP deployment, accidental friendly destruction, no deliberate sacrifice/prohibited flags, reachable unspent qualifying debris, after combat, full minute, unused short-rest allowance.
cases.expected: Eligible refund 1 RP; consume that instance’s qualifying usable debris and the feature’s allowance. Enemy cause is not required.

cases.given: Same record, but destruction is deliberate sacrifice, the object itself is a copy, or an applicable no-resource/no-own-destruction-chain exclusion forbids recycling.
cases.expected: Reject the prohibited branch; the absence of an enemy-cause requirement does not waive these independent exclusions.

cases.given: A normal crafted recipe-596 deployment costs 0 RP; its owner later pays 1 RP for Field Repair and buys a service pack.
cases.expected: No refundable deployment RP is created. Repair/activation/servicing/GP price are not deployment payment.

cases.given: Qualifying original debris was already consumed by one successful Recycling, Salvage, Reaper or Snap use; later a new label, repair or second destruction is offered.
cases.expected: No second material claim. The initial object-linked opportunity and consumed material history persist; owner short-rest allowance is not refreshed by switching devices.

cases.given: Friendly accidental destruction qualifies for Recycling; a player also requests Scrap Salvage, enemy-hit Reaper or Volatile using that same cause.
cases.expected: Do not propagate Recycling’s predicate. Each other effect retains its own enemy/enemy-hit conditions, flags, timing, costs, slot rule and limits.

cases.given: A device expires/is dismissed rather than destroyed, or a real device is hit by copied damage.
cases.expected: Administrative ending does not become destruction. Copied incoming damage does not by itself mean the device is a copied object; use actual inherited flags and each effect’s genuine predicate.

cases.given: Attempt before combat ends, out of reach, without acquired feature, with an already spent short-rest use, or without the actual required minute.
cases.expected: No benefit through this summary. Keep all actual source eligibility, time and frequency restrictions.

cases.given: Correct the two advanced guides and their JSON counterparts.
cases.expected: Public operatingGuideText equals the entire corrected public guide; internal TD-13/text equals its exact corrected full paragraph. All 167 internal/100 public cards, 48 source comparisons, bodies/hosts and historical sourceVerdictSha256 values remain unchanged.

cases.given: Crimson Agent 8 without known Spill Control; same character reaches class 9 with current BG 2.
cases.expected: Capacity 3 becomes 6 automatically; current BG remains 2. No optional Spill Control purchase is required at 9.

cases.given: Eligible pre-9 Crimson Agent knows Spill Control and then reaches class 9.
cases.expected: Capacity is already 6 and remains 6, not 9 or 12. Gain cap 2/round and encounter reset 0 remain.

cases.given: Recharge 2 used on regular turn 1. Follow turn end, extra Action, extra turn, regular turn 2 start, then regular turn 3 start.
cases.expected: Counter stays 2 through the non-tick boundaries, becomes 1 at regular start 2 and 0 at regular start 3. No extra activation is supplied.

cases.given: Owner cannot act at their regular initiative start; later out-of-initiative six seconds elapse across an already counted boundary.
cases.expected: The real regular start still ticks; elapsed-time procedure cannot double-count that tick.

cases.given: A source effect ends at turn end while another has start-of-turn expiry; a reset targets a zero counter or repeats on the same named counter in one numbered round.
cases.expected: Keep each native deadline. Zero counters are not legal reset targets and spend no reset use; the same positive counter gets at most one reset/shortening per round. No RP/per-rest refill.

cases.given: Core-default binary-effect task at DC 10 with natural 1 and +9 modifier; contrast basic dismantling with the same die/total.
cases.expected: Core applies its downward degree shift before collapsing and fails. Basic dismantling meets DC 10 and succeeds because its explicit procedure has no natural shifts.

cases.given: Natural 1 with a large crafting modifier; natural 20 in crafting; total 20 in tool-assisted dismantling without a qualifying quality source.
cases.expected: Crafting natural 1 is Mishap, natural 20 receives only its numerical band, and the separate precision threshold alone grants no generic harvest critical, unit or preparation award.

cases.given: An attack beats AC by 10, or a saving throw beats its DC by 10.
cases.expected: No generic task-critical consequence is imported into those native attack/save procedures. The glossary remains 48 terms.

cases.given: Follow the nine corrected teaching artifacts’ direct links/anchors and the five character-navigation substitutions.
cases.expected: All direct links/anchors resolve; inverse navigation notes restore the original text with explicit line-ending normalization. No foundational numbers or sources change; current/maximum, records and audience boundaries persist.

cases.given: Keep the character PDF byte-identical or alter only an authorized presentation label.
cases.expected: Unchanged PDF retains the verified five pages/364 fields/hash. Any PDF regeneration requires repeating all-page visual and field save/reopen tests, not a new mechanics conference.

cases.given: Apply post-fulfillment status updates.
cases.expected: Preserve frozen archive, originals, old reports and source statuses; refresh current hashes and five named TC coverage notes with actual receipt. Only teaching/presentation labels and TC’s resolved note change; broader areas remain open.

cases.given: Record completion of this authored presentation gate.
cases.expected: Carry 687/433 recipes, LAX/NWX/LRX and 412/436 authored spell scope. Do not promote class/feat/pending spells or enable standalone runtime selection. Final joint flow → authorized push → verified remote → careful cosmology, without a new owner-confirmation gate.
